children: Solana Foundation Vice President of Technology Jacob Creech said Solana will undergo several major changes in the near term. According to Foresight News, the first phase of rent relief will begin next week, Transaction V1 will go live on September 9, slot time will be shortened further, and the Alpenglow upgrade will launch in October. He also said the community will hold the Scale or Die conference in November.

title: Solana to Launch Rent Relief, Transaction V1, and Alpenglow Upgrade in Coming Months
